key_path: No self-serve path. Airbnb API (Homes/Activities API at developer.withairbnb.com) is for invited Preferred Software Partners only; Airbnb's partner managers reach out to prospects.
If invited: sign partner agreement -> Partner Portal access -> create app -> sandbox (Sandbox V2) -> certification -> production.
No guest/booking API and no official MCP; consumer agents can only browse the website (subject to robots).

agent_native_auth.evidence: https://developer.withairbnb.com/ (Partner Portal); secondary sources on invite-only program

mcp.directories: Not in Claude directory (claude.com/marketplace/connectors/airbnb 404). Not a ChatGPT app: CEO Brian Chesky said in Oct 2025 the Apps SDK 'wasn't quite robust enough'; still absent as of Oct 2026. Only unofficial scraping MCPs (openbnb, Apify) exist.

docs_for_agents.robots_ai_stance: GPTBot and ClaudeBot: Disallow /. ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, anthropic-ai, PerplexityBot, meta-externalagent get their own groups (allow /calendar/ical/, many disallows). Claude-User not named (falls under *).

score_justification: Invite-only partner API, no MCP, no consumer agent integration, and training crawlers blocked; an agent has no sanctioned path at all.
best_practice: Explicit per-agent robots groups (distinguishing user-triggered ChatGPT-User from GPTBot training) is at least a deliberate policy.
biggest_gap: No sanctioned agent surface of any kind; strategic choice to wait for richer agent SDKs.
